description: This file contains utility functions for managing organization domain configurations, including extracting organization slugs from hostnames, generating URLs, and constructing database query clauses related to organizations within a multi-tenant application.

methods.name: getOrgSlug
methods.description: Determines the organization slug based on hostname and optional forced slug, considering test modes and single org configuration.

methods.name: getOrgDomainConfig
methods.description: Returns organization domain configuration, optionally forcing a specific slug if in platform mode.

methods.name: orgDomainConfig
methods.description: Deprecated function to get organization domain configuration from an HTTP request, using headers and hostname.

methods.name: getOrgDomainConfigFromHostname
methods.description: Generates organization domain configuration based on hostname, fallback, and forced slug.

methods.name: subdomainSuffix
methods.description: Returns the subdomain suffix based on environment and URL.

methods.name: getOrgFullOrigin
methods.description: Constructs the full origin URL for an organization based on slug and environment.

methods.name: getSlugOrRequestedSlug
methods.description: Creates a Prisma query clause to find a team by slug or requested slug.

methods.name: whereClauseForOrgWithSlugOrRequestedSlug
methods.description: Creates a Prisma query clause to find an organization by slug or requested slug, ensuring it is an organization.

methods.name: userOrgQuery
methods.description: Generates a Prisma query for the user's organization based on request headers and fallback.
